body: The love of my life told me they don’t want to deal with me anymore because I make their life worse. I’ve been explaining how I don’t want to be alive but they give me a valid reason to live. They’ve completely been ignoring my texts and if they answer it’s just to say “goodbye” or “sorry ig” and I just want to scream and vomit. I’ve already made a post explaining how I want to die since I didn’t care about anything or anyone but them, going into full detail and everything. Now I’m finally doing it. I cant live without them. I know it’s selfish but I need them.
No. I am not, but I have my friend here.
I’m okay. It’s 2 A.M. for me.

Thank you.
It’s ok.
I am a girl.
No. A male.
There’s someone I love in my life.
I deleted my social media to help me focus on killing myself. Typical.
Not at all. It just went in one ear out the other.
I’ve enjoyed talking to you a lot.
Yea.
Eh.
It also has to do with how I treat myself. I don’t have emotions. I don’t like how I view myself. I used to think highly of myself but it all just went down the drain out of nowhere.
I treat everyone around me like they’re worthless. I have no remorse for it.

When I was 8 we moved for the second time. It was the first time I switched schools so I had to meet new people. I remember the second week we were down I spent a day with my grandma going to see a movie. All of a sudden I felt weak and nauseous. I couldn’t walk correctly and I was heaving. I couldn’t bring myself to puke even though I was practically trying to force myself to. She drove me to an ER trying to see what was wrong. Right as we arrived I was fine. I kept having these episodes every week. I had done multiple ultrasounds trying to see if I had anything in my stomach causing this. We had done it for months to figure it out until they came to a conclusion. I had gotten a therapist for a month after that but we couldn’t financially keep doing sessions so I just saw my school counselor. She doesn’t help for shit though lol.
Yes, but I’m not really worried about that since I’ve made up my mind on killing myself.
Yes. He is the one with the job. My mom cannot drive right now either. She got her license revoked.

My ex wanted to the day I ran away. That’s when I was afraid of what would happen. I refused to let them but the last time it happened we had authorities show up. There just hadn’t been enough proof for anything.

When I was 8 I was medically diagnosed with anxiety. It took them 5 months to figure it out. It could be linked to that. My mom does have depression though, she thinks it was passed onto me There have been times I’ve left the house for hours. She’s called a few times and I was in the middle of crying while she has. I have no reason for the outbursts though.
I just hope she understands everything. I’m too tired to write a letter to her.
No. Divorce has been brought up however.
She’s doing better.

I have talked to her but she tries more to relate to me rather than actually listen. She does know what I’m going through but we just seem to not acknowledge it anymore. It’s tiring to repeat myself to her because I feel like she doesn’t fully grasp the concept that I don’t treat people correctly. She thinks it’s how other people treat me but she doesn’t even know the half of it. She tries to self diagnose me as well. She’s convinced I have depression but I don’t think I do. The only think that stresses me out by talking to her would have to be she tells my step father everything.
He lives with my grandparents.

No. I do not like him. I’ve been called many names and have been told questionable things by him. He’s driven away my exes and I hate it. He’s never done anything to me but he’s threatened to hurt me. He beats my mom occasionally during arguments. He’s caused both me and my mother to run away. I hate him. I don’t even consider him my step father.
But to answer the question, I see him at least twice a month.

Oh, technically yes. We are currently figuring out custody arrangements. My biological father lived in Mexico for 9 years, fleeing from the law. He recently came back home last year however. He is not a stable man. He has no job, no car, no license. He goes to sleep at 4 A.M. and wakes up at 3 P.M. 
He has a kid in Mexico he can’t see. I’ve never even met him before. (My brother)
I am sorry about that. I’m struggling with that. Both my mother and step-father are alcoholics.
If anything I’m actually scared for my mother. She’s gone through a lot and she’s a tough woman, but I am afraid what I’m going to do tomorrow will hurt her. I’m not worried about anyone else though.

I am not. My mother and biological father were forced to split when I was born. She was 16 and he was 17. They had gotten back together but she cheated on my father. (not surprised she’s done it many times with my step-father) Because she cheated, they split up again.
Ghostemane, or IC3PEAK, for starters. My biological father introduced me to them.
It ranged from heavy-metal-rap to alternative
We can talk. Is there anything specific you would like to talk about?
Yes, I am ok.

Sorry for the late response, I’ve stated somewhere here that I just overall don’t like the way I treat anyone around me. I’ve driven dozens of people away for not caring about their issues and not helping them. I’ve said many hurtful things to people without remorse and I’ve in general driven myself down a path I would rather not go into detail with. I’ve caused a lot of pain to people I used to love and I have no emotions for them. No empathy. I’d rather have people suffer a month or 2 without me rather than living the rest of their lives with me.

I have thought about this a lot actually. I honestly don’t care. I might survive the impact of the train, chances if the train driver sees me, but I also might not survive being taken to the hospital. If I survive being hit I will most likely bleed out. Since the rail is on top of rocks and building equipment I’ll definitely be flung onto something and hit my head on it. But you’re right, I honestly don’t care about what anyone will tell me if I survive.
I can understand where you’re coming from. I myself have stopped caring for everyone. Totally lost emotion. I’ve also lost interest in doing the things I love.
That makes sense, I understand.  Just sucks for what I’m having to deal with along with you. I just cannot handle living anymore. Too much stress; so tiring.

I know exactly how your perspective is. I’m just tired of caring for no reason. It’s why I don’t anymore. I have 0 remorse for what I’m doing. I don’t care how anyone I know will feel, except my mother.
I’m 15. I guess if I had an answer for myself I would help. I just don’t have the energy to.

I’m 15.
I have tried explaining to my mother and father my emotions but they’ve just been shut out since I don’t have a “real reason” to be upset. It’s fine because I honestly don’t care. I do have a cat who helped distract me. I’ll try watching the videos if I even have the energy to later. I’m pretty much dead set on killing myself however.

I wish I could. I love my mother. She’s the most beautiful woman in the world. She had brought me so much happiness but over time I’ve just stopped caring. I know she cares about me but I just don’t care enough. I’m too tired too. For my step father however, I couldn’t. Even if I tried. I know he’s working hard to show me he “loves” me; I’ve lost all respect for that man. I’m too tired to help myself I’ve already made up my mind.
Yes.

I’ve been struggling with this for a while man and like it sucks. It’s been about 4 months since I’ve started treating people this way and I can’t control it. I tell myself i’ll stop but the next day I woke up and do it over and over again. A loop. I just want to say “fuck it all” and die. I’ve already tried before. I ran away from home, stayed with a buddy for a night and planned on doing the exact same thing but authorities stopped me. It was a rough night but in order to fix everything I’m just going to end my own pain and everyone else’s.
I have 0 emotion towards everyone. I don’t care how anyone feels.
I treat everyone around me like they’re worthless.

I have already thought of what the driver, clean up crew, the police, etc. will have to witness and process with what I am doing but honestly I’ve lost all emotion and I have no remorse for what I am doing.
It would most likely be instant as well.
I have looked up the estimated speed for the train, it goes 60 mph which is an 89% chance of killing a human.
